result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭與擴產類負向 finding（supply_demand_durability#2）已列入 threats、blind_spots、R1、Single Thing；競爭軸另有條目也已引用，沒有漏接的負向條目。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots[0]","reason":"supply_demand_durability#2 的擴產與低價競爭風險已寫入 Bear 機率 30%、premortem、triggers 與 R1，並說明成品板產能可逆；供給可逆性已進機率。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"關稅／去中化（reg_tariff_export#2）接進 R3、trigger 6 與 blind_spots；重訊澄清（major_events#0）接進 trigger 7；材料缺料（geo_supply_chain#2）接進 R2；有 finding 的開放軸都有人接住。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.market_wrong_reason_given","reason":"市場錯在哪有具體機制（擴產規模與時點已公開、倍數卻在歷史端點之上）；wait_for_price=true 與觀望一致，條件（≤410 元且毛利率 ≥27%）可驗，410 元≈FY2027 共識 11.8 倍也算得過。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"customer_second_source、customer_concentration_credit、regulatory_antitrust、substitute_technology、channel_business_model_shift 五軸皆 none；查詢詞切題，判斷也誠實標示「客戶占比事實表未涵蓋」，屬查不到的資料級缺口。但客戶軸只有 2–3 次通用查詢，而 moat 的「客戶在多家認證供應商間分配」主張缺證據，僅給 🟡。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.roic_durability.endo_ceiling","reason":"reinvest_rate（1−58.3/102.2≈43%）與 roiic（約 125%）都有算式；Bull/Base/Bear EPS 價差實質（55／35.5／21），終端價 1100／532.5／252 與 scenario_meta 對得上。endo_ceiling 留空是因資產負債表缺料，已設 endo_ceiling_exceeded=true 並說明，屬資料級缺口；Base EPS 路徑從 2028 年開始下滑，basis 文字卻寫 2029 年下行，是小瑕疵。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.fact_refs","reason":"引用的營運指標皆為 Q2 2026 與 7 月營收（最新），沒有比 latest_quarter_kpis 更舊的項目；共識 EPS 標明為 Q2 財報前（2026-08-01），賣方目標價標明資料止於 2026-05，也未被當唯一依據。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"無前份（prior_dd 為 no_prior_dd），不適用漂移歸因；程式歸因條目已帶入。"}]
